handoff.salientSummary: Fixed VAL-API-017 bug in GetEvaluationStatus handler to return progress=100 for completed evaluations. Handler now computes progress=100 when status is 'completed' regardless of stored database value.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Modified GetEvaluationStatus handler to override progress to 100 when status is 'completed'. The handler now computes progress based on status: if status is completed, progress is set to 100; otherwise it uses the stored eval.Progress value.

commandsRun.observation: All 8 test cases passed including TestGetEvaluationStatus_CompletedState
